name: Natural Biocon (India) Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, Natural Biocon Ltd is engaged in the trading of agricultural 
produce.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
NBL is engaged in the business of agricultural activities, which deals in extracting, processing, 
and manufacturing agrochemicals and natural alkaloids—like nicotine, caffeine, morphine, and others—from plants, seeds, and agricultural produce. It also deals in barley malt, maltose, 
malt sugar, and their derivatives, with operations covering import, export, procurement, assembly, and trade of these products.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.38 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 66.1 days to 14.9 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.79% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 247 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -11.9%
